# Research synthesis

Follow [the editorial contract](../../../docs/editorial-contract.md). Read relevant prior evidence, preserve sources and unresolved contradictions, then update the private turing.state.md summary if needed.

Record claims, evidence strength, source links/dates, exact support, uncertainty and open questions. Keep bulky evidence in linked private supporting artifacts rather than duplicating it in every context. Preserve source details needed to audit a claim. Distinguish new findings from unchanged evidence and record which current draft claims they support.

Use the existing project slug and artifact map. Do not research indefinitely or treat a dossier's existence as verification of the latest draft.
